historical_protocol.intake: Original 36 qualified configurations from iteration_03; EX28 parameter probes are diagnostic evidence, not an automatically expanded contender set.
historical_protocol.selection_disclosure: Successor method approved after seeing previous results. Baseline precision is inherited from iteration_03. New diagnostic precision and conventions are fixed in this file before this build; this is not blind validation.

original_goals.return: CAGR >= 1.5 * same-scenario buyhold CAGR; if buyhold <= 0, strategy > 0 and > buyhold
original_goals.drawdown: Drawdown magnitude strictly smaller than same-scenario buyhold

historical_protocol.parameter_scope: EX28 fixed 16-position six-parameter joint design, equal position weights; holding period fixed at2. Other modules remain auxiliary and are not pooled.
historical_protocol.statistical_policy: Reuse original configuration bootstrap and original-family PBO/DSR with hashes and explicit scope. Append EX28 184 standard evaluations plus184 cost stresses to the historical ledger; do not claim old PBO/DSR covers the expanded history.

historical_assessment.statistical_evidence_scope: Old configuration bootstrap and old-family PBO/DSR; expanded history disclosed but family statistics not recomputed.
historical_assessment.scope: Fixed original36 contender set; EX28 probes diagnostic only; changed ranking is posthoc development evidence.
unmeasured: Balanced joint geometry for32 other contenders

historical_ranking_policy.frequency_policy: Original hard interval [4,6]; within interval values equally satisfy goal; not a maximize/minimize objective.
historical_ranking_policy.precision_reason: Return/return-loss steps0.001 mean0.1 percentage point; drawdown steps0.0001 mean0.01 percentage point; concentration step0.01 means1 percentage point of positive net PnL. These are declared comparison granularity, not statistical error bounds.
historical_ranking_policy.comparison: Lower Pareto layer first. Within layer compare declared binned metrics lexicographically; first unequal known metric decides. Missing value at an earlier tied prefix makes that pair incomparable; never skip or impute it.
historical_ranking_policy.ties: All seven binned values known and equal means economic display tie; config ID is display-only.
historical_ranking_policy.partial_ranks: Minimum possible ordinal position = strict ancestors+1; maximum = layer size-strict descendants. Exact rank only if bounds coincide; tied entries share their minimum position. Missing metrics may be disclosed even when an earlier metric decides a pair.

coverage_gaps.policy: Requests only; no extra evaluations launched. Prioritize actual unresolved decisions, keep other coverage gaps visible.

historical_recommendation.reason: Follow declared first decisive metric; preserve downside, statistical scope and missingness in assessment.

user_approval.verbatim: 同意晋升621，请你先收尾阶段四
user_approval.scope: 批准621晋升为开发池策略候选；本轮先收尾阶段四。

preferences: 较小联合扰动年化退化
selection_basis.other_configurations: 未获本次晋升批准；保留全部身份、证据和排序，不标记为淘汰。

limitations.detail: 三个窗口相互重叠，其中完整开发池始于2025年；均为已见开发数据，不能视为三次独立验证。
621完整开发池年化43.11%，低于618的49.81%；原收益优先排序保留。
621固定2天联合扰动仅1/16满足原全部目标，618为5/16；621联合年化退化9.26个百分点小于618的14.94个百分点，不等于全面更稳健。
621滚动超额Q10为-17.37%，618为-14.63%；联合回撤恶化1.28个百分点大于618的0.99个百分点。
7月起窗口621仍亏损1.30%；YTD两者频率均6.369，超过原区间上沿6，但原合同按403日完整开发池核验，子窗口不回写原达标状态。
反复搜索及选择偏差保留；旧PBO/DSR未覆盖全部后继研究。四中心20bp联合扰动均未达原收益目标。
原32个非首层配置缺主联合模块，15配置涉及9对不可比关系，000193另缺同源码成本证据；保留原additional_checks。未完成盘口、容量、延迟和独立前瞻验证，子窗口未重跑参数扰动。

effective_user_decision.next_action: 阶段四收尾交付后，按用户推进指令制作621的阶段五开发池候选包；沿用已批准的配置身份，候选ID按候选契约另行分配。

search_ledger.old_statistics_scope: Original EX13—EX27 search family; no coverage of EX28 or all prior S010/mechanism research claimed
search_ledger.counting_note: Evaluation calls, unique configs, behaviors and trials are different units; do not sum them as independent hypotheses.

formula_identities: Pressure CAGR = standard CAGR - pressure loss; pressure absolute CAGR is omitted from Pareto to avoid repeated level objective.
Parameter degradation includes the center level but ranks loss under the same joint geometry, not absolute perturbed CAGR.
Frequency is an original hard interval, not an additional maximize/minimize objective.
Bootstrap/family bias do not rank configurations; old auxiliary diagnostics are not additional ranking votes.
common_denominators: Positive closed net PnL denominator used only by concentration
Same initial cash and session length for all CAGR comparisons
metric_overlap_audit.overlap_judgment: Economic domains separated; correlations and shared data remain, no claim of statistical independence.
